spec.kitLine: 18 normal attacks vs Anti A.T. Field
spec.scope: Normal-attack landed-hit counter only; the 590.64% proc is skill flat damage (no core unless stated; crits only if engine default for riders says so — text is silent).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant proc, no duration; counter accumulates across reloads.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:18 (counts ROUNDS; AR hitsPerShot 1 so rounds == pulls) AND gated on the boss holding the named status 'Anti A.T. Field' (requiresTargetStatus). NOTHING in this kit applies that status — it is externally sourced (collab peer), so the block is inert in any comp without an external applier.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Ungated hitCount:18 dealing 590.64% of final ATK every 18 rounds all fight — a massive standing over-credit (~+45% of her normal-attack output) in comps where the status never exists.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In the standard controlComp (no Anti A.T. Field applier present), the event log contains ZERO damage events with mult ≈ 590.64 for the entire fight; her total is unchanged when this block is deleted via withPatchedOverride.
spec.inertness: Must move NOTHING in every comp lacking an external Anti A.T. Field inflictor — i.e. every current fixture.

spec.scope: Stack-ledger mutation of an externally-sourced named status.
spec.durationSemantics: Stack count, not a timed buff.
spec.triggerIdentity: Same 18-hit status-gated trigger as the proc above.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing a resource pool + damage scaling for a status the sim has no carrier or consumer for.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply / resource activity attributable to this line; belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

spec.kitLine: 7 normal attacks while in Attack State
spec.scope: Normal-attack landed-hit counter, live ONLY while the OWNER holds the 'Attack State' self-status — which this kit grants exclusively via HER OWN burst (10 s).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant 286.37% proc; the eligibility window is the 10 s Attack State, i.e. roughly her own-burst FB windows.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:7 gated to the Attack State window. The engine has no self-status gate primitive, so the faithful encoding is hitCount:7 + fbGate:'inFb' + ownBurstGate:'cast' (window ≈ her burst's 10 s; the ~0.4 s cast→FB offset is an accepted approximation). Counter should count hits landed IN the window, not carry from outside it.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) ungated hitCount:7 running all fight (~+28% of normal output over-credit); (b) window keyed to ANY team Full Burst (plain fbGate with no ownBurstGate) — over-fires on rotations where the co-B3 bursts instead.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: controlComp includes helm as a second Burst III, so rotations split. Assert: every damage event with mult ≈ 286.37 falls inside a ≤10 s window opened by HER burstCast; on rotations where helm bursts (her Attack State absent), ZERO 286.37 events; outside all FB windows, zero events.
spec.inertness: Zero procs outside her own Attack State windows; zero procs on co-B3 rotations she sits out.

spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding the range line as a rangeOk/range-bonus buff or the units-affected line as a generic team buff.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply attributable to these lines on any FB enter; verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

spec.targetSet: allies in Annihilation State status — empty in every current comp.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applying casterAtkPct 17.6% (flat ≈ 0.176 × 118,027 ≈ 20,773) to ALL allies on every FB enter, stacking on top of skill2's 11.61% — a standing team-wide over-credit.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to check the driver against: (1) TRIGGER SPLIT — the burst self-mode (Attack State) is burstCast-keyed while skill2's team buff is fullBurstEnter-keyed; controlComp's helm co-B3 makes these observably diverge, so any test that only counts per-FB applications without distinguishing WHO burst is blind to the over-credit. (2) BOTH skill1 damage riders are status-gated (boss-held 'Anti A.T. Field' / self-held 'Attack State') — an encoding where either hitCount rider free-runs all fight is the single largest plausible over-credit in this kit. (3) The 17.6% Annihilation-gated ATK must NOT be folded into the unconditional 11.61% team buff — assert exactly one team-wide casterAtkPct apply per FB with flat value ≈13,703 (0.1161×118,027) and none ≈20,773. (4) All three 'of the skill user's ATK' lines are casterAtkPct and flat-resolve at apply time (11.61%→≈13,703; 63.36%→≈74,782 self; buffApply values are flat ATK, never the raw kit percentage). (5) The 990.2% nuke is FB-exempt by cast timing — inFullBurst/fbMajorApplied must be false. (6) Durations are all distinct (9 s / 10 s / 13 s) — a copy-paste 10 s across blocks is detectable. (7) skill2 block 1's target is a COMPOUND gate (MG weapon AND burst-casters this rotation); if the driver modeled it at all, dropping the burst-caster half is the likely miss. (8) hitCount counts ROUNDS; AR hitsPerShot=1 makes rounds==pulls here, so no divergence to test on this unit. All magnitudes are kit-text (DATAMINED); nothing in this kit requires a ⚑ calibrated value — a shipped ⚑ would itself be a finding.
